findings.detail: The field reads scratch/probe_time.log. That file is the pre-repair reproduction of the old ValueError (polygon circuit 828 has no quadrature points); it has no bare EXIT= last line and no failing test id, so it is not admissible against the negative-control field. The run's actual refusal exercise is tests/test_unseen_source_full_plant.py::test_negative_control_entry_without_geometry_is_refused, whose log is scratch/negative_control.log (1 passed in 97.25s), and no red log for the polygon-quadrature repair's negative control (restore the bounding-box grid and the thin-strip test fails) is present in the run directory.
findings.summary: negative_control_log names a pre-repair probe traceback that carries no EXIT= line, so the negative-control admission cannot read it.

findings.detail: The import was live in the pre-refactor plasma_linked_flux, which measured the reciprocity kernel before rejecting it on cost; after the shaped path moved to section_grid the import was left behind. A ruff check of the file returns exactly this one F401.
findings.summary: polygon_greens is imported but never used, a leftover of the reuse refactor; ruff F401 fails on the file.

findings.detail: The gate log records a DeprecationWarning at linkage.py:133 ('Arrays of 2-dimensional vectors are deprecated') on every invocation. The value is a weight denominator in polygon_quadrature, so a future NumPy raise would break every shaped-section plant build.
findings.summary: polygon_quadrature computes its triangle areas with np.cross on 2-D vectors, which NumPy 2.x deprecates and a future release removes.

findings.detail: section_quadrature returns (r, z, weight) for one polygon section, as polygon_quadrature now does for a PolygonSection. The node consolidated the (r, z, weight, owner) concatenation into section_grid, which is the right move for that shape, but the quadrature rule itself was added as a third sibling rather than offered back to the owner. The new triangle-fan rule is strictly better than that owner's bounding-box grid, so the improvement belongs at the owner.
findings.summary: section_quadrature already owns interior quadrature points and area weights for a polygon cross-section; linkage.polygon_quadrature duplicates the capability without extending it.

findings.detail: polygon_plasma_flux reproduces polygon_quadrature's points, weights and current-share product for one section; its only callers are tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py:413 and :437. It is a second entry point for a capability section_grid already serves.
findings.summary: polygon_plasma_flux duplicates section_grid's shaped branch for a single section and has no production caller.

findings.detail: The plan's third check reads that the reconstruction arm agrees with the DINA-path plant within 1e-3, which resume-3-advice.txt redefined and resume-4-advice.txt closed as strict-xfail pending a DD3-to-COCOS-17 translator. The node correctly did not edit the plan, so the coordinator owns reconciling plan section 6 with the landed state before promotion reads it.
findings.summary: Plan section 6 still carries data-status=implementable and a done-when whose third clause names the DINA reference, disagreeing with the closure the run landed.
